notes: 11 available. OUT: Andrew Amann #21, Sang Lee, John Flinn #19, Matt Watson, Kyle Doherty, Luke McArdle. That's our top bat/LCF (Amann), our leadoff/1B (Sang), our best 1B (Flinn) and our best 3B (Watson) all gone in one night - the infield is down to the studs. So the middle is forced: Dennis Marks at SS all 7 (only shortstop), Ed Fitzpatrick at 2B all 7 (his best spot), and Jon Sorenson covers 3B innings 1-4 then slides to 1B innings 5-7. Eric Klatt pitches innings 1-4 then takes 3B; Joe McLean plays 1B innings 1-4 then pitches innings 5-7 (Klatt/Joe split the mound 4/3). Perry DiLibero moves up to LCF (Amann's spot) and Thacher Knight is the everyday LF - both go wire-to-wire because they're the only two left-side outfielders available. That leaves the right-side crew - Bruno, Cheever, Coulombe and Konen - to rotate through C/RCF/RF with one resting each inning. Seven iron men play all 7; the rotation handles the rest.
sits_note: Eleven bodies, ten gloves, so exactly one lucky soul gets a bench cameo each inning - blink and you'll miss your rest. Seven players never touch the pine: Marks (the last shortstop on Earth), Klatt (arm today, hot corner later), Joe McLean (first base, then the mound), Ed Fitzpatrick (2B is his kingdom now), Sorenson (3B, then 1B - the human utility knife), DiLibero (promoted to center-left, no days off) and Knight (the only other outfielder allowed on the left side). With the infield this thin, those seven don't have understudies - they ARE the show. Everyone else pulls right-side duty: Bruno, Cheever and Coulombe each grab two breathers while Konen gets just one, and the catcher's mask rotates through Bruno, Cheever and Coulombe so nobody's knees unionize. Nobody sits back-to-back, everybody bats regardless - SIT just means a one-inning fielding nap. Fewer errors, fewer naps. It's a redemption arc, box-score edition.

opponent_lineup.source: 2025 scouting (42 PA on file): a pull/left-heavy, right-handed attack - 15 balls in play to the LEFT side vs 8 to the right, roughly even IF/OF depth (14/16). Shade the defense left / left-center and make them earn it the other way.
